title: Customer shows the customer's company name
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. The report shows a work order with a customer that has a company name, and one with no customer name.
steps:
1. Read the Customer cell of the row whose customer has a company name.
  2. Read the Customer cell of the row with no customer name.
expected:
1. The Customer column shows the customer's company name.
2. The cell is blank when no customer name exists.
